articles.author: Jeran Wittenstein
articles.title: AI’s Wobbly House of Cards Puts Markets and US Economy at Risk - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: The heads of America’s leading AI development labs have started a national conversation about tapping the brakes on a technology that’s offering so much promise for society, while at the same time showing it can do a frightening amount of harm.
